reproduced_blocker.message: the old duplicate guard treated every request-name prefix as a training identity

normal_jobs_api_submit_gate.message: preview does not disable failed-job alerts

repair.duplicate_rule: recognize only the exact request-name plus eight lowercase hexadecimal characters, or explicit run/output metadata
repair.sfs_rule: use a live SFS check twice when mounted; inspect root and target with lstat, accept only FileNotFoundError as target absence and reject every other inspection error; otherwise require an exact plan/request-bound observation no more than five minutes old and revalidate its binding and age after server dry-run

supported_remote_receipt_producer.terminal_workload_gate: exact Job-UID owner, Kueue v1beta2, training-lq, training-cq admission, effective priority 10000, one zero-GPU main PodSet, Admitted=True and Finished=True; q1 remains exact on the persisted Job label because the live Workload priority-class name is null

repair.server_and_readback_rule: before intent, reject any unreviewed field in the Jobs API source preview, including RayJob, RayCluster, replica/autoscaling, Pod, Secret source, app or init sidecar, privilege, host pin, affinity, runtime class, scheduling overhead, effective GPU quantity, durable SFS/storage/init or identity drift; then require the API-server dry-run/create response to equal that reviewed intent after only observed harmless defaults; collect only one exact admitted Workload, one exact-UID successful Pod and one sanitized receipt line
repair.runtime_output_guard: the SFT bootstrap creates the .runtime directory exclusively

remaining_gate: merge the reviewed repair, create and collect one exact fresh zero-GPU SFS observer receipt, then consume it within five minutes in the one-time direct SFT command
